filter: disasterNumber eq 4332 and censusBlockId ge '482010000000000' and censusBlockId lt '482020000000000'
notes: Aggregated public registration records, not verified unique persons.
Reported household members are summed within registration records; people may be underrepresented or duplicated across registrations.
Missing or invalid household sizes are not imputed.
Flood-damage records are a cleanup-priority indicator, not labeled cleanup requests.
specialNeeds applies to a household and does not count injured individuals.
County selected from geocoded census block prefix 48201; records with missing or miscoded census blocks are excluded.
